_readme: PIN SOURCES — where each platform's map pin lives, declared at onboarding after looking in ALL FOUR places
(the rendered ad page · its embedded JSON / data attributes / network calls · a site-wide map or list feed · the parent
project/compound page). Owner 2026-10-30, after rakez served 3,660 ads with 0 pins for six weeks while its map page's
feed named every project's lat/lng. Read by scripts/verify-pin-capture-declared.ts (launch checklist box 10) and seeded
into ops_pin_source_declared, which mon_detect_pin_coverage_below_floor() holds the served index to every hour (P1).
pin_source: ad-page | page-json | feed | project-page | partial | none. floor_pct: none ⇒ 0, anything else ≥ 1
(1 = «publishes: at least one served pin»; above 1 = a percentage of served ads, judged at ≥ 50 served ads);
a ratchet — raise it when a fix lands, never lower it to clear a red (a drop is an incident). proof_url: the page that
shows the pin, or the page proven silent. A platform absent from this file fails `npm test`.
Changing a row is a TWO-place edit: this file AND a `*_pin_source*` migration carrying ('platform', 'source', floor).
